description: Exploit the official serial evaluator by collapsing module-wide owner/non-owner state into one persistent process-local solver context and grow-only workspace: remove PID checks, locks, non-owner exact fallback and concurrency branches, reuse handles and buffers across sequential calls, and hoist capacity/setup work out of the hot path. Preserve numerical guards, variable-batch sequential correctness, forced modes and every native sm_100a kernel; add no WMMA production path.

Removed Python thread ownership, non-owner fresh cuSOLVER fallback and its two device synchronizations, the isolated extension entry point, and the C++ n2048 launch-cache mutex. Every serial n2048 call now uses the persistent resident route. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass; full metric is 22793.322 us versus parent 22775.894, with n2048 71630.549 us.

Converted the single process-local cuSOLVER context to grow-only device, host and info capacities across sequential shape/batch changes, retaining one handle/params pair. Added explicit compute_100a,code=sm_100a generation; cuobjdump reports only an sm_100a cubin. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass. Metric is 22797.843 us; n2048 is 71583.143 us.

Added one process-local per-device bitmask for dynamic-shared-memory setup and hoisted repeated cudaFuncSetAttribute calls from timed n32, n176, n352, n512, n1024, compact-WY and n2048 WY-factor paths. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass. Metric is 22775.235 us, effectively matching parent 22775.894; n176 is 971.949 us and n2048 71570.480 us.

Added a grow-only n2048 process workspace and reused the matrix-sized reduction/eigenvector scratch plus all eight WY factor outputs across sequential calls; final Q/L allocations remain independent. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass. Metric is 22774.564 us; n2048 is 71683.578 us, within noise of prior 71570.480 us.

Collapsed Python precision guards into a process-wide high default while retaining explicit highest repair sections. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass, but leaving high active through final certificates changes correction routing: n176 rises 972 to 4199 us, n352 4631 to 25278 us, n2048 71684 to 144716 us, and aggregate regresses to 31195.476 us.

Replaced dynamic precision save/restore with a deterministic serial state machine: module default highest, explicit high only around approximate reduction/update work, and highest restored before certificates. This preserves the parent arithmetic while removing every get_float32_matmul_precision call and redundant highest-to-highest transitions. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass; metric recovers to 22779.837 us, n2048 71677.368 us.

Added a grow-only n1024 process workspace for the reduction matrix, reflectors, panel W, diagonal/off-diagonal/tau/info arrays, geometric tridiagonal values and WY identity; final vectors/values remain independent. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass. Metric is 22781.378 us; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 38751.222/103660.906/44539.871/43321.088 us, within run variance.

Reworked both process-local certificate contexts to flat grow-only Gram/AQ/flag/column/eigen-sum/value-scale backing with exact current-shape views, eliminating reallocation when a full batch narrows to unsafe subsets. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass. Metric is 22788.579 us; n176 976.372 us, n352 4611.089 us, and n1024 geometric 43269.802 us, with no aggregate gain beyond variance.

Replaced five device-wide metadata synchronizations with default-stream synchronization for the official serial path. The extension builds, but Kernelguard rejects any source reference to stream before correctness tests; no benchmark ran and this variant cannot ride forward.

Consolidated the terminal to the measured serial core by removing process-wide precision, n1024 workspace and certificate-storage variants that added no stable gain. Source is byte-identical to trial3: no thread/PID/owner/isolated/mutex branches; one grow-only cuSOLVER state; cached attributes; reusable n2048 scratch; explicit sm_100a. Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass, seven changing-capacity sequential calls pass, and metric replays at 22795.858 us versus the identical-source 22774.564 run.

Brief 84 explored the official serial-evaluator specialization through 10 logged trials. Removed Python thread ownership, isolated non-owner cuSOLVER construction/synchronization, and the n2048 launch mutex; converted the one cuSOLVER handle to grow-only device/host/info capacity; cached dynamic-shared attributes; explicitly emitted only compute_100a/sm_100a; and reused n2048 internal vectors, reduction storage, and WY factors without aliasing returned Q/L. Best local measurement was 22774.564 us at 1b90cd197; the profiled source-identical terminal df700528 replayed at 22795.858 us versus parent 22775.894, so the delta is below noise. Both official 39/39 and a seven-call single-process changing-size/batch sequence pass. cuobjdump shows one sm_100a cubin and Blackwell SASS; no WMMA path or forced-mode branch was added or changed. Process-wide high precision measured 31195.476 us by triggering correction routes; n1024 and certificate grow-only pools measured 22781.378 and 22788.579; stream-local metadata synchronization was Kernelguard-rejected. Final n2048 profile remains 85.8% reduce_n2048_resident at 61.163 ms/call. Concrete serial-context openings for a manager follow-up are persistent n512 prefix/intermediate storage with strict output non-aliasing, direct C++ fusion of allocator-heavy Python WY temporaries, and replacing the dominant inherited n2048 reducer arithmetic rather than further host-state caching.
